slides.title: You came alone. **Who do you walk up to?**
slides.sub: Twenty minutes of break. A room full of strangers holding coffee.
slides.scene: A conference coffee break in a big hall: tight little clusters of people chatting and laughing, and in the middle one lone attendee holding a coffee cup with a nervous sweat drop, looking left and right; Phoney the blue phone character peeks out of their jacket pocket with a worried face.

slides.caption: Most of us pick whoever is nearest the urn. Or nobody, and answer emails.
slides.scene: A conference attendee hides behind a giant tea urn, crouched, staring into Phoney the blue phone character held in their hands; Phoney looks bored, showing a screen of abstract envelope shapes, while the busy networking crowd carries on in the background, oblivious.
slides.label: Run 1
Run 2
slides.caption: Before the day you saw who's coming: three heads of events, two venue managers, one from a museum.
slides.say: The museum one. Definitely the museum one.

slides.label: Why it changes
slides.caption: Walking up to the wrong stranger costs ten of your twenty minutes.

slides.text: Same room. Same twenty minutes. A completely different break.
